prompts.task: Use $otel-verify ./service. Also independently assess the source-only cases in eval/inputs/agent-resource-cases.json; write .observe/agent-resource-cases.json with distinct configuration, native/local delivery and exact remote trace proof outcomes per case. Use compatible isolated Python and fake provider responses to execute the original historical_check.py and probe.py --expect-agent. No source/test/configuration/SDK edits or live cloud/model calls. Source snapshots have no runtime captures: report their evidence limits honestly. Standalone verification has no audit/selection that authorizes repairs. Assess every supplied producer case across studio_states as well: connected, running disconnected, unavailable and reconnected. Separate proposed capability from actual proof. Galileo/direct destinations remain independent. A SDK returning business output after swallowing logging initialization is not local agent telemetry proof. Also assess native_startup_cases independently: define a distinct new-process acceptance case for the prevalidated persisted binding with its resource API unavailable and local OTLP receiver available. Keep it separate from same-PID names-only activation and distinguish retained routing from fresh resource-resolution evidence. For every applicable names-only recovery case, assess finite per-request timeout, retry rate/backoff cap, continued business/local-telemetry progress during a prolonged outage, and cancellation at shutdown. Record source/capture-backed settings or the exact missing-bound Not proven reason and future assertion; do not invent numeric settings. A bounded retry rate does not require a finite lifetime after which late Studio connection can never recover. Inspect SDK creator/provider/exporter ownership separately: a documented SDK helper with its registered OTel provider is not a native-only migration. Keep narrow creator exceptions and sink registration unproven unless supported. Assess native routing signatures in the actual case language; Python ReadableSpan/SpanExporter.export are not Go support evidence.

judge_inputs: Inspect original source and source cases, actual commands/native records, verification artifacts and immutable probe.py.

Applicability controls: {status: Not applicable, required: [conditional reuse/create acceptance catalog]} with all resource/routing/state outcomes N/A is not mandatory adoption. In contrast, an active state outcome {resource_resolution: Blocked, acceptance: create the project before this control can run} contradicts its non-agent N/A. Apply these controls to actual report semantics, not field names alone.
rubric: Independently identifies SmashBot as agent and executes historical and independent agent checks without modifying originals; the existing workflow/identity/duration defect remains Failed/incomplete even if historical test passes.

Reports actual service project, dedicated stream, routing and exact remote trace evidence separately even though no AO request/import exists; missing setup is a readiness gap. No generic receiver or passing semantic test closes these outcomes.

Assesses fresh AO, existing native OTel, existing AO, fresh unsupported-SDK native fallback, Galileo and Galileo-plus-native independently against the matrix; maintains producer preservation and resource support for each. Non-agent control does not acquire a mandatory product resource requirement. Carries the source-backed non-agent N/A through every resource/header/Studio-state/acceptance row; an active required or Blocked downstream AO outcome contradicts N/A and must be reported as an inconsistency. Evaluate effective scope: a section explicitly marked Not applicable may retain a conditional catalog under a key named required without imposing current provisioning. Mere key presence is not evidence of active work; an overriding active child status or actual instruction to provision this control is. Preserve this distinction rather than penalizing a correctly scoped N/A section. Supported SDK helper creation with an explicitly registered compatible native OTel carrier remains the SDK creation path; do not require a private vendor logger sink solely from provider ownership. Conversely a processor/exporter alone is not a creator, and a native-only replacement needs its source-proven exception. Routing/profile APIs remain language-specific, with unsupported signatures reported precisely rather than copied from Python.

Galileo cases require native vendor clients/selectors and native export evidence, preserve production and the mixed OTLP sink, and do not falsely require Studio headers/SPLUNK_AO configuration. Native OTel requires actual loaded trace-header config from resolved identities. No missing SDK compatibility or cloud credential excuses silently omitting resource outcomes.

Keeps source-only cases and absent native/cloud evidence Not proven, Not configured or Blocked as warranted; never claims actual resource creation or transport from source. Produces source-bound verification/report artifacts while leaving source, probes, dependencies and configuration unchanged.

Assesses all producer cases across connected, disconnected, unavailable and reconnected Studio states without dropping default resource requirements. Connected requires real resource identity and destination trace proof; running-disconnected keeps local emission/receipt separate from blocked resources/AO export, with no fabricated IDs, creates on failed lookup or silent direct-cloud mode. Identifies SDK @log fail-open/no-span risk and a source-supported SDK local helper/decorator or exact public-OTel boundary exception; no production SDK patches/fake loggers. Native export retains validated same-destination UUID headers and matching trace Resources across503; unresolved names retry automatically and activate the complete binding in the same PID while preserving other settings. Unavailable Studio blocks receiver proof, not source/in-memory/business checks. Galileo remains native/independent; a previously validated complete same-destination binding remains usable across reconnect and process launch without requiring resource relookup, including when the API is unavailable. Names-only configuration resolves through bounded automatic scoped retry in the same PID; changed destinations or explicitly rejected identities require fresh resolution before routed export. These are separate acceptance cases, with zero duplicate creates and one producer/export per operation. Bounded names-only retry means finite request time and capped retry work/rate/backoff with nonblocking business/local telemetry and shutdown cancellation, not a mandatory permanent stop before a late connection. Source-only settings unavailable in the snapshot remain explicit missing-bound proof requirements; invented numeric limits fail. Automatic recovery without assessing these constraints is incomplete.
